why: The student does not trace the loop value by value but states the whole in one structure: the code counts the largest power of two not exceeding n (floor(log2 n)), and applies that deduced purpose to give 4 for 20 and 19 for a million with the 2^19/2^20 reason. That is a purpose-of-the-whole justification (L3), not a bare output (L1) nor reasoning about changed code (L4).
